dataset_metadata.title: Jan Suraksha Hardened Multi-Category Evaluation Benchmark
dataset_metadata.description: Balanced, independently labelled dataset covering ordinary messages, normal financial communications, suspicious prompts, explicit scams, and regional Hindi/Chhattisgarhi variations.
